[ModInitializer(nameof(Initialize))]
public static partial class ModEntry
{
    private static readonly Dictionary<string, Texture2D> Textures = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private static readonly HashSet<string> TextureAssets = new(StringComparer.Ordinal) { @TEXTURE_ASSETS@ };
    private static bool LocalizationPatched;
    static partial void Configure();
    static partial void InitializeDialogue();
    static partial void InitializeSprites();
    static partial void InitializeAudio();
    static partial void InitializePresentation();
    public static void Initialize()
    {
#if BUILDER_NATIVE_TESTS
        NativeProbe.Initialize();
#endif
        if (!LocalizationPatched) {
            // Restore only this assembly's inline text before native UI listeners
            // observe replacement locale tables. ModelDb.All is empty at startup.
            new Harmony(@MOD_ID@ + ".character-localization").Patch(
                AccessTools.Method(typeof(LocManager), "TriggerLocaleChange"),
                prefix: new HarmonyMethod(typeof(ModEntry), nameof(RestoreLocalization)));
            LocalizationPatched = true;
        }
        Configure();
        InitializeDialogue();
        InitializeSprites();
        InitializeAudio();
        InitializePresentation();
        GD.Print(@MOD_ID@ + " initialized (standalone character; BaseLib 3.4.7).");
    }
    private static void RestoreLocalization(LocManager __instance)
    {
        foreach (var model in ModelDb.All.Where(m => m.GetType().Assembly == typeof(ModEntry).Assembly)) {
            if (model is not ILocalizationProvider provider || provider.Localization is not {} entries) continue;
            var table = provider.LocTable ?? (model.Id.Category switch {
                "CHARACTER" => "characters", "CARD" => "cards", "RELIC" => "relics",
                "POTION" => "potions", "POWER" => "powers", "EVENT" => "events", _ => null });
            if (table == null) continue;
            __instance.GetTable(table).MergeWith(entries.ToDictionary(e => model.Id.Entry + "." + e.Item1,
                e => BaseLib.Patches.Localization.SimpleLoc.TrySimplify(e.Item2)));
        }
    }
    public static Texture2D Texture(string name)
    {
        if (!TextureAssets.Contains(name)) throw new InvalidDataException("Undeclared character texture: " + name);
        if (Textures.TryGetValue(name, out var cached) && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(cached)) return cached;
        var path = Path.Combine(Path.GetDirectoryName(typeof(ModEntry).Assembly.Location)!, "assets", name);
        using var image = new Image();
        var error = Path.GetExtension(path).Equals(".svg", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            ? image.LoadSvgFromString(File.ReadAllText(path)) : image.LoadPngFromBuffer(File.ReadAllBytes(path));
        if (error != Error.Ok || image.IsEmpty()) throw new InvalidDataException("Invalid character art: " + path);
        return Textures[name] = ImageTexture.CreateFromImage(image);
    }
}

        ("description", "At the start of combat, gain 1 Focus. Each Focus grants 1 Block at the end of your turn."),
        ("flavor", "A little practice goes a long way.")];
    public override async Task BeforeCombatStart()
    {
        var context = new BlockingPlayerChoiceContext();
        await PowerCmd.Apply<FocusPower>(context, Owner.Creature, 1, Owner.Creature, null);
    }
}

// Amount is the native saved, run-local power counter; no cross-run state is introduced.
public sealed partial class FocusPower : CustomPowerModel
{
    public override PowerType Type => PowerType.Buff;
    public override PowerStackType StackType => PowerStackType.Counter;
    public override string CustomPackedIconPath => ModelDb.Power<StrengthPower>().PackedIconPath;
    public override string CustomBigIconPath => ModelDb.Power<StrengthPower>().ResolvedBigIconPath;
    public override List<(string,string)> Localization => [("title", "Focus"),
        ("description", "At the end of your turn, gain {Amount} Block.")];
    public override async Task BeforeSideTurnEnd(PlayerChoiceContext context, CombatSide side, IEnumerable<Creature> participants)
    {
        if (participants.Contains(Owner)) await CreatureCmd.GainBlock(Owner, Amount, ValueProp.Unpowered, null);
    }
}

internal static class CardData
{
    internal static readonly Dictionary<string, JsonElement> Rows = Load();
    private static Dictionary<string, JsonElement> Load()
    {
        using var stream = typeof(CardData).Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream("CharacterCards")!;
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(stream);
        return doc.RootElement.EnumerateArray().ToDictionary(r => r.GetProperty("id").GetString()!, r => r.Clone());
    }
}

public abstract class CharacterCard : CustomCardModel
{
    private JsonElement Row => CardData.Rows[GetType().Name[5..]];
    private JsonElement Values => Row.GetProperty(IsUpgraded ? "upgrade" : "base");
    private int Number(string name) => Values.GetProperty(name).GetInt32();
    protected CharacterCard(string id) : base(
        CardData.Rows[id].GetProperty("base").GetProperty("cost").GetInt32(),
        Enum.Parse<CardType>(CardData.Rows[id].GetProperty("type").GetString()!),
        Enum.Parse<CardRarity>(CardData.Rows[id].GetProperty("rarity").GetString()!),
        Enum.Parse<TargetType>(CardData.Rows[id].GetProperty("target").GetString()!), autoAdd: false) { }
    public override CardPoolModel Pool => ModelDb.CardPool<CharacterCardPool>();
    public override Texture2D CustomPortrait => ModEntry.Texture(Row.TryGetProperty("portrait", out var portrait)
        ? portrait.GetString()!["assets/".Length..] : "card.svg");
    public override string PortraitPath => MissingPortraitPath;
    public override string BetaPortraitPath => MissingPortraitPath;
    public override IEnumerable<string> AllPortraitPaths => [];
    public override bool GainsBlock => Number("block") > 0;
    protected override IEnumerable<DynamicVar> CanonicalVars => [
        new DamageVar(Row.GetProperty("base").GetProperty("damage").GetInt32(), ValueProp.Move),
        new BlockVar(Row.GetProperty("base").GetProperty("block").GetInt32(), ValueProp.Move)
    ];
    public override IEnumerable<CardKeyword> CanonicalKeywords => Row.GetProperty("exhaust").GetBoolean() ? [CardKeyword.Exhaust] : [];
    public override List<(string,string)> Localization => [("title", Row.GetProperty("name").GetString()!), ("description", "{Rules}")];
    protected override void AddExtraArgsToDescription(LocString description) => description.Add("Rules", Rules
        .Replace("{Damage}", DynamicVars.Damage.ToHighlightedString(false))
        .Replace("{Block}", DynamicVars.Block.ToHighlightedString(false)));
    private string Rules => string.Join(" NL ", new[] {
        Number("damage") > 0 ? "Deal {Damage} damage" + (TargetType == TargetType.AllEnemies ? " to ALL enemies." : ".") : null,
        Number("block") > 0 ? "Gain {Block} Block." : null,
        Number("draw") > 0 ? $"Draw {Number("draw")} card(s)." : null,
        Number("energy") > 0 ? $"Gain {Number("energy")} Energy." : null,
        Number("focus") > 0 ? $"Gain {Number("focus")} Focus. Each Focus grants 1 Block at the end of your turn." : null
    }.Where(s => s != null));
    protected override async Task OnPlay(PlayerChoiceContext context, CardPlay play)
    {
        if (Number("damage") > 0) {
            var attack = DamageCmd.Attack(DynamicVars.Damage.BaseValue).FromCardCompatibility(this, play);
            if (TargetType == TargetType.AllEnemies) attack.TargetingAllOpponents(CombatState!);
            else attack.Targeting(play.Target!);
            await attack.Execute(context);
        }
        if (Number("block") > 0) await CreatureCmd.GainBlock(Owner.Creature, DynamicVars.Block, play);
        if (Number("draw") > 0) await CardPileCmd.Draw(context, Number("draw"), Owner);
        if (Number("energy") > 0) await PlayerCmd.GainEnergy(Number("energy"), Owner);
        if (Number("focus") > 0) await PowerCmd.Apply<FocusPower>(context, Owner.Creature, Number("focus"), Owner.Creature, this);
    }
    protected override void OnUpgrade()
    {
        var basic = Row.GetProperty("base"); var upgraded = Row.GetProperty("upgrade");
        DynamicVars.Damage.UpgradeValueBy(upgraded.GetProperty("damage").GetInt32() - basic.GetProperty("damage").GetInt32());
        DynamicVars.Block.UpgradeValueBy(upgraded.GetProperty("block").GetInt32() - basic.GetProperty("block").GetInt32());
        EnergyCost.UpgradeBy(upgraded.GetProperty("cost").GetInt32() - basic.GetProperty("cost").GetInt32());
    }
}
